notes:
• New setup: a few short questions build your first week (goal, experience, days and equipment), or skip and explore.
• Getting started: a checklist on Home that ticks itself as you start a workout, log a meal, add your weight or a measurement, and add a friend.
• How to use ForgeQuest: a guide in Settings and Profile with Show me buttons, and a way to turn the tips back on.
• Friends: buttons react instantly, rows slide away smoothly, and Go train can be sent every 4 hours on a friend's training day.
• The muscle map filter now shows every muscle, with labels and a chip list.
• Fixes: Google Drive never overwrites a backup this phone hasn't seen without asking; Harder version keeps sets you already did; sets ticked by Finish and tick all never become records; warm-up sets no longer count in your recap and charts; a friend's score shows their own breakdown.
• App lock was removed.
